title: research: archive conditional GCC libexec generator and phase source frame
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Archive the accepted conditional SOURCE component for the GCC `STANDARD_LIBEXEC_PREFIX` question. The supplied `rules.conf` direct parameters recipe emits version/SONAME/LIBC_DEP metadata and no direct layout/flag assignments. This resolves the named generator-source question while preserving the key gap: the 928-byte source-package parameters (`~24.04`, without `.1`) are not the actual build 32148542 generated phase file, and configure-time evidence does not establish patch-time selector continuity or later property preservation.

The exact native recipe candidate is `/usr/libexec/gcc/`; the literal cross-install patch supplies `/usr/libexec/gcc-cross/`. The Phobos release-check plus `--with-target-system-zlib=auto` discriminator is conditional on the applicable unoverridden configure recipe. The contribution does not claim semantic noninterference of every generator/include action. Installed initializer, Q3, full compiler-input closure, full bootstrap-control campaign and field qualification remain HOLD/false. A directly bound actual property may replace exhaustive phase reconstruction; a whole final `gcc.o` export is not imposed as the sole engineering method.

This is a self-contained **SOURCE-ARCHIVE**, with frozen frame/reviews/corrections, all 21 declared-available source-pin bodies (880,523 bytes) as byte-exact inert `.txt` snapshots, two explicitly unavailable helper bodies, Pro consultation response and small receipts, complete retained source licenses, and source/path/hash/blob/mode mapping. The original frame wording calling 98.950533479 canonical is corrected externally without changing the frozen original: canonical 94.550533479 + source/publication supplemental 0.74+3.66 = combined 98.950533479 at source freeze; subsequent bounded archive checks add 0.83, making the current supplemental combined 99.780533479 policy seconds. The frozen package retains its earlier reporting checkpoint; this PR description records the later check ledger without rewriting that package. Physical/outside/historical/final costs remain OPEN_NOT_ZERO. No budget reset or execution grant follows.

The optional driver-input reports retain previously reported raw literal data and two 64-byte hex windows. No ELF/binary is vendored or reread. File offsets and string presence establish no section, symbol, stripping, address, initializer, reached use, source/binary correspondence or behavior. Pro consultation is outside this result.

## Task and overlap

Original source investigation: [PR #6321](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6321). Frozen H25 benchmark: [PR #6029](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6029). Immediate predecessor: [PR #6434](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6434).

Base: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, tree `e6898c8ba7a27b71587c32ba3f639259ceeeed91`. New package only: `research/h25-gcc-libexec-phase-frame`. Scope is **refined** from the explicit compiler-input closure and the bootstrap-control campaign assignment to this accepted conditional source component; no task picker, shared code, controller/parser or selected-frontier change occurs.

Exact retained source links include the input-constructor head `120072d58ddb46f0e02886756243174d41fce42e` and generated configuration head `97dd394ce1ddf00cc80dfdaad71767fdbc85af47`. [PR6397](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6397) is a separate criterion/method archive. [PR6434](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6434), head `edc2820ba023b804ef1351a88e2fe31bf8d489dd`, separately delivered pilot failure accounting and source/fake-only controls. This archive adds the direct-generator frame and explicit continuity/preservation obligations, without borrowing those checks as original installed-field qualification.

Native compiler queries, shell calibrations, original baseline runs and bootstrap-control campaign cases remain 0. The eight-job pilot remains closed with source and synthetic evidence only; it is not resumed.

**Publication scope:** parent reports fresh 23:24 UTC canonical main unchanged at the base/tree above, authenticated fork `Clear1nsight` with push permission, and a bounded read of 100 open-PR metadata records. This is not a full diff/discussion overlap search or a novelty result. Local committed head is `16c1e87f30e9f053462ed7562bcb48aa6d785d06`, sole parent `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`, tree `cc952810b330731093e55bf6816f057a2c56bc97`; the remote branch/tree/sole-parent readback is now verified as recorded below; complete PR file-list readback, Chrome submission and hosted delivery remain pending at this form checkpoint. Local Git object alternates are preparation machinery, not complete-history or cold-public-dependency claims.

## Validation

The source frame and retained independent AI source review are exact frozen artifacts, distinct from human/proof-kernel acceptance. SOURCE-MAP binds every copied origin/payload with byte count, SHA256, computed Git blob identity, conversion and mode. GCC formfeeds and raw bytes are preserved; anchors count LF only. Full Debian copyright, entire retained GCC GPL-3 texts, GCC runtime exception and exact Apache-2.0 root-license copy are included. Missing selected prefix.cc/make-relative-prefix.c remain missing; no source acquisition, archive listing/decode or provenance repair was performed.

New `integrity.py` performs only exact-file inventory, regular/nonexecutable file checks, hashes and JSON metadata mapping against an externally reviewed MANIFEST SHA256. It imports no archived source, starts no subprocess and performs no network/native/compiler/decoder operation or file write. It assumes a stable filesystem: separately named reads are not an atomic snapshot or race-safe custody and do not establish full acquisition provenance. Package `.gitattributes` disables content normalization/filters locally so raw evidence can be committed unchanged.

Independent exact export source review **PASS** binds the frozen 62-file / 1,270,925-byte archive, MANIFEST SHA256 `207a739dfc70a7e216093a1936a3e4bb1c171e85e7024d80a9dc28e14893efde`, checker SHA256 `22637ba30acc7825a992bdd4aa29479705141d1f495ef168f8ff4108eecb0140`, package subtree `9ec099ed827a97ace94e53c962b4f465927005f8` and full tree `cc952810b330731093e55bf6816f057a2c56bc97`. The external source-review JSON is 13,342 B, SHA256 `2fddffcd52dfe294380d0b549b1215406aec9c56b47533f8af1f03cf70f3ccca`.

The parent then executed the specifically granted static-integrity checks: normal **exit 0**, optimized **exit 0**, exactly one read-only Git-free cold copy **exit 0**, and exactly one disposable one-byte-tamper control **expected exit 1**, observed as required. Package source remained unchanged; source and cold payload comparisons agreed. Parent ledger `LEDGER-001.json` is 6,266 B, SHA256 `49c872e7a87fc0cab3163321cd300161b13d29280f65a1869ad9d90b54ab28cd`; its current policy debit is 0.83 s including copy work. Normal/optimized/cold GNU-time wall values are each 0.18 s; tamper 0.16 s; copy preparation 0.08 s. Individual maximum RSS, not complete process-tree peak, was reported. The current supplemental combined policy total is 99.780533479 s; canonical 94.550533479 remains unchanged and physical/outside/historical/final costs remain OPEN_NOT_ZERO. Raw parent check/review receipts remain external local evidence; the PR description reports those outcomes without implying they were vendored into the frozen archive.

In a separate bounded local-commit phase, direct Git comparisons confirmed all 62 working/index/committed payloads byte-for-byte with mode 100644 and only the 62 package additions relative to the sole parent. The local commit is `16c1e87f30e9f053462ed7562bcb48aa6d785d06` with tree `cc952810b330731093e55bf6816f057a2c56bc97`. Every source payload also completed strict UTF-8 decode/encode and serialized transport roundtrips without normalization. `check_research_commit.py` is **not applicable** because it requires a registered `VERIFY.json`; no official preflight pass is claimed. The unrelated inherited missing base PDF object remains missing locally; `write-tree --missing-ok` preserved its existing reference without acquisition or history repair.

`git diff --cached --check` returned 2 with 23,160 B of preserved raw frozen-source whitespace warnings; these were not silently repaired or presented as a clean whitespace check. No original imports, native builds/queries, original baseline or bootstrap-control campaign cases ran in either preparation or the local-commit phase, and the local-commit agent ran no checker/tests/replay. Reproduction of the static archive check:

```sh
python3 -B research/h25-gcc-libexec-phase-frame/integrity.py --manifest-sha256 207a739dfc70a7e216093a1936a3e4bb1c171e85e7024d80a9dc28e14893efde
python3 -B -O research/h25-gcc-libexec-phase-frame/integrity.py --manifest-sha256 207a739dfc70a7e216093a1936a3e4bb1c171e85e7024d80a9dc28e14893efde
```

**Remote branch verified; PR and hosted delivery pending at submission:** published fork head `e83090c937b920affc87593f02b535e6c9773615` has sole parent `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a` and exact reviewed tree `cc952810b330731093e55bf6816f057a2c56bc97`. Remote branch is `Clear1nsight:codex/h25-gcc-libexec-phase-frame-20261102T234007Z`. The Git Data commit uses the authenticated account identity and a different message from local commit `16c1e87f30e9f053462ed7562bcb48aa6d785d06`; tree and sole parent match exactly, but the commit SHAs are deliberately distinguished. Chrome draft submission, complete current PR file-list readback, exact-head hosted CI and public handoff remain pending at this form checkpoint. The package README and original source-freeze receipt intentionally remain the unchanged pre-execution checkpoint; later parent checks are reported here.

There is no `VERIFY.json` replay hook; the retained base's package guide allows a source archive. Hosted outcomes must be read for the eventual exact head. A plan pass with replay skipped supplies archival/planning evidence only. The observed static integrity passes establish supplied-byte consistency only, not source-origin truth, scientific acceptance or source-to-binary behavior.

A separate independent validation cross-review passed at 23:43:23.707 UTC. It read all 15 raw streams/time files and the grant/tool-results/ledger, independently compared the source, cold and exactly one-byte-mutated copy, recomputed the 0.83-second debit, and bound the stored local commit to the frozen 62 blobs. Report SHA256: `a2df588882f1ded2be7769b216b70637fbbf8154d4234f2fd4b6735bb3b2b4af`. This is static archive and local-commit evidence, with no checker rerun by the reviewer and no scientific qualification. Canonical main was refreshed again immediately before branch publication and remained the pinned base.

## Credit

Retain GCC/Free Software Foundation copyright and GPL-3.0-or-later source notices; Debian GCC Maintainers and all named Debian/Ubuntu upstream/packaging holders are preserved in the complete exact copyright file. The retained runtime exception is not asserted for compiler-driver source. Existing CrocSwap contributor/reviewer work and original frozen reports keep their attribution. Upstream root Apache-2.0 license remains unchanged; new documentation/metadata/checker are Apache-2.0 contributions. Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex / GPT-6.1 Sol assistance. No third-party snapshot is relicensed.

## Open next questions

See the package README's structured open questions. The smallest useful follow-up is a separately bounded feasibility decision on the specifically nominated actual-driver input: can an engineering/source/ISA/correspondence argument establish the applied prefix property, relevant preservation and consequential use while rejecting unused/overwritten-literal explanations? State source model, ABI, ISA, loader and context premises explicitly. The blocker is an accepted actual-property/correspondence slice; neither this source archive nor its publication creates that certificate or grants decoder/native/target execution.

Exact applicable helpers and independently bound Q3 context remain separate blockers. Stronger archive-to-body equality is needed only if a later inference actually relies on it; no new decode/acquisition is mandated here.
